description: Returns all docker daemon connections configured in Uptime Kuma. These are referenced by docker container monitors via docker_host.

includeSecrets.description: Return credentials in full instead of "***". Off by default: this output is persisted in conversation transcripts and logs. Can also be enabled globally with UPTIME_KUMA_INCLUDE_SECRETS=true.

name: listDockerHosts

dockerHosts.description: Array of docker host configurations. Any credentials embedded in a dockerDaemon URL read "***" unless includeSecrets is set.

dockerDaemon.description: Unix socket path (e.g. /var/run/docker.sock) when dockerType=socket, or TCP URL (e.g. http://docker-proxy:2375) when dockerType=tcp

dockerType.description: Connection type: "socket" for a unix socket path, "tcp" for an HTTP/HTTPS URL

name.description: Human-readable name for this docker host

title: List Docker Hosts
